title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-10

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a strong show highlighted by a soaring Morning Dew and a fine Black Peter, with generally good audio and an energetic Stephen Stills cameo.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its ragin' flow and especially the unorthodox, jug‑band‑style interplay between Jerry Garcia and guest Stephen Stills, with Morning Dew singled out as a three‑dimensional highlight.  The soundboard source delivers clear, pleasant sound overall, though some listeners note the first half sounds rougher and the mix can feel a bit uneven at times.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars, emphasizing strong musical moments and generally good soundboard quality; minor criticisms about early‑set roughness keep the rating just below top‑tier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as "nice" and "sweet, 3‑dimensional," indicating clear soundboard capture, though a few note the first half sounds rough/ugly and the mix can be uneven.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is lauded for its aggressive, flowing energy with a powerful second half; early portion is described as rough but the overall pacing builds to an excellent finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for intertwining with Stephen Stills in a jug‑band style and delivering energetic guitar work throughout.
